about_short_description.short_description: Saudi Company For Hardware - SACO is a hardware retailing and wholesaling business.

product.name: Hardware Products
product.description: A range of hardware items including tools, building materials, and home improvement supplies for retail and wholesale customers.

product.name: Household Tools and Equipment
product.description: Various household tools and equipment for everyday domestic use and maintenance tasks.

product.name: Gift Cards
product.description: Prepaid gift cards usable for purchasing a wide range of products at SACO stores and online within a one-year validity period.

product.name: Installation and Delivery Services
product.description: Services for the installation and delivery of purchased products to customers' locations.

product.name: Maintenance and Repair Services
product.description: Post-sale maintenance and repair services for products bought from SACO to ensure functionality and customer support.
